items.prompt: After this change, which entry does a full cache drop when a new key is added?

options.rationale: That was the behaviour before the change.

options.text: The entry whose last use is oldest
options.rationale: The loop now keeps the smallest lastUsed.
Insertion order is not consulted; recency is.
The choice is deterministic for a given clock.

items.prompt: What would break if this line were changed back, and which test would catch it?

required.idea: The cache would drop the entry just used

items.modelAnswer: Changed back, the cache would drop the most recent entry instead of the oldest, and the first test (drops the least recently used key) would fail.

items.prompt: Explain to another reviewer what this change guarantees, and one thing the passing tests do not prove.
items.modelAnswer: It guarantees the oldest entry, the one used longest ago, is dropped when the cache is full. The tests do not prove that no other caller relied on the old order.
